title: Made in Hong Kong (bc30)
synopsis: Made in Hong Kong opens with the voice of Moon, the young protagonist of the story, explaining to the viewers what his destiny is already certain to be: he has dropped out of school and become a part of the local small-time underworld. As the movie shows, there is no way out for young people in Hong Kong.

synopsis_lang.en: Made in Hong Kong opens with the voice of Moon, the young protagonist of the story, explaining to the viewers what his destiny is already certain to be: he has dropped out of school and become a part of the local small-time underworld. synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 《香港製造》是陳果「97三部曲」的首部，講述四名被社會遺棄的邊緣和弱勢年青人的故事。中學生阿珊受情傷後選擇自殺；中秋因家庭破裂而淪為街頭流氓；阿屏患上不治之症，其父欠債後拋妻棄女；智障的阿龍則被利用偷運白粉。這四名問題青年命運多舛，只有中秋活下來向社會作出控訴 ……

cast: Sam Lee Chan-sam, Neiky Yim Hui-chi, Wenders Li Tung-chuen, Amy Tam Ka-chuen
